bouquet.ask.1: Hey @… mind if we talk for a second?
bouquet.ask.2: I’ve been carrying this feeling around, and it keeps pointing at you.
bouquet.ask.3: @, every time you walk by my heart skips. Do you notice it too?
bouquet.ask.4: The days feel brighter when we’re together. Does it feel that way for you?
bouquet.ask.5: Strange question, but… have you ever pictured us as more than friends?
bouquet.ask.6: Could we talk a moment? I need to tell you something important.
bouquet.ask.7: I’m nervous, so I’ll just say it—being near you makes me happy.
bouquet.ask.8: Whenever I see you, the world softens. Do you feel that?
bouquet.ask.9: I keep finding excuses to visit you, but this time I would like to ask you something.

bouquet.ask.11: I value our friendship, @, but my heart hopes for more.
bouquet.ask.12: The stars looked beautiful last night—yet I thought of your smile instead.
bouquet.ask.13: Hey @…, My day feels unfinished until we speak. Is it the same for you?
bouquet.ask.14: Would it be strange if I said you’ve become my favorite person?
bouquet.ask.15: @, every little thing you do lingers with me. Does that mean something?

bouquet.ask.18: I practiced this in the mirror… Do you see me the way I see you?
bouquet.ask.19: Sometimes I catch myself smiling for no reason—then I realize it’s because of you.
bouquet.ask.20: I can’t keep pretending it’s just friendship. May I ask… do you feel the same spark I do?
